needs.name: Autonomous Refueling
needs.description: Enable refueling operations without human intervention to reduce error risks.

needs.name: Multi-Platform Compatibility
needs.description: Unmanned and legacy manned aircraft refueling support

needs.name: Contested Environment Operation
needs.description: Maintain functionality in GPS denied, electronic warfare contested or adverse weather.

needs.name: Secure Communication
needs.description: Ensure reliable and tamper-proof communication between tanker and receiver.

needs.name: Collision Avoidance
needs.description: Detect and avoid potential collisions to prevent mid air accidents.

needs.name: Redundant Fail-Safe Systems
needs.description: Incorporate multilayered redundancy for critical subsystems.

needs.name: Mission Reliability
needs.description: Maintain ≥95% mission success rate when operating in nominal conditions.

needs.name: Health Monitoring & Diagnostics
needs.description: For critical subsystems, maintain real time monitoring and predictive fault isolation

needs.name: Regulatory Compliance
needs.description: Meet airworthiness, cybersecurity and safety standards as per authority guidelines

needs.name: Threat Detection & Response
needs.description: Real time identification and mitigation of electronic warfare, jamming or airborne threats

needs.name: Testability & Verification
needs.description: Support standardized and validated test protocols for autonomous operations and sensor performance.

needs.name: Human-Machine Interface (HMI)
needs.description: Intuitive operator interfaces with manual override capability.

needs.name: Lifecycle Support
needs.description: Enable efficient repair, upgrades, and sustainment over a 10-year service life.

needs.name: Integration with Tanker Platforms
needs.description: Must be compatible with KC-46 and future tanker fleets with minimum alterations

needs.name: Operational Efficiency
needs.description: Key performance metrics (for example, fuel transfer rate, downtime) should be tracked and reported

needs.name: Mission Coordination & Scheduling
needs.description: Coordinate refueling missions with ground control, prioritize requests, generate schedules, and communicate status updates to aircraft and operators

requirements.name: Autonomous Refueling
requirements.statement: The system shall execute autonomous refueling via onboard sensors without human assistance.

requirements.name: Refueling Time
requirements.statement: The system shall complete refueling within 10 minutes (T), 8 minutes (O) of handshake (alignment) with receiving aircraft.

requirements.name: Proximity Safety Abort
requirements.statement: The system shall abort refueling if the receiving aircraft proximity exits established safe bounds.

requirements.name: Aircraft ID Verification
requirements.statement: The system shall verify and validate receiving aircraft identity before beginning fuel transfer.

requirements.name: Turbulence Stability
requirements.statement: The system shall maintain a stable connection with the receiving aircraft during turbulence.

requirements.name: Probe Alignment Accuracy
requirements.statement: The system shall align the refueling probe within 0.5m (T), 0.25m (O) of the receiving aircrafts fueling port.

requirements.name: Fuel Leak Detection
requirements.statement: The system shall detect fuel leaks and cease fuel transfers immediately.

requirements.name: Adaptive Fuel Speed
requirements.statement: The system shall adjust refueling speed based on receiving aircraft stability.

requirements.name: Probe Retraction
requirements.statement: The system shall retract the refueling probe when refueling has completed

requirements.name: Multi-Platform Refueling
requirements.statement: The system shall employ refueling procedures for both manned and unmanned aircraft.

requirements.name: Wingspan Compatibility
requirements.statement: The system shall support refueling for autonomous aircraft with wingspans of  5m-15m (T), 5m-18m (O).

requirements.name: Fuel Flow Adaptation
requirements.statement: The system shall adjust fuel flow rate based on receiving aircraft type and properties.

requirements.name: Multi-Fuel Support
requirements.statement: The system shall support ≥ 3 (T), 4 (O) fuel types (eg. Jet A, Jet A-1, Jet B, etc.).

requirements.name: Fuel Capacity Check
requirements.statement: The system shall verify receiving aircraft fuel capacity before transfer.

requirements.name: Altitude Boom Adjustment
requirements.statement: The system shall automatically adjust the boom length to compensate for altitude differences in receiving aircraft.

requirements.name: Fuel Port Adaptation
requirements.statement: The system shall automatically calibrate and adapt to account for variations in fuel port configurations on receiving aircraft.

requirements.name: Altitude by Aircraft Type
requirements.statement: The system shall automatically adjust its altitude based on receiving aircraft type.

requirements.name: High-Altitude Refueling
requirements.statement: The system shall support refueling at altitudes up to 35,000 feet (T), 40,000 feet (O).

requirements.name: GPS-Denied Navigation
requirements.statement: The system shall operate in GPS-denied environments by automatically switching to alternate navigation methods.

requirements.name: Electronic Warfare Operation
requirements.statement: The system shall maintain functionality during electronic warfare conditions.

requirements.name: Adverse Weather Operation
requirements.statement: The system shall operate without degredation in operational capability in adverse weather conditions (rain, fog, winds ≤25 knots).

requirements.name: Inertial Navigation
requirements.statement: The system shall utilize inertial navigation when GPS is not available (GPS denial, outages).

requirements.name: Low-Visibility Sensors
requirements.statement: The system shall switch to optical sensors in low-visibility conditions.

requirements.name: Mission Task Prioritization
requirements.statement: The system shall automatically prioritize mission-critical tasks over non-critical tasks during contested operations.

requirements.name: Terrain Navigation
requirements.statement: The system shall employ terrain-based navigation in GPS-denied environments.

requirements.name: Extreme Temperature Range
requirements.statement: The system shall operate in temperature ranges of -35C to +50C (T), -40C to +55C (O).

requirements.name: Contested Positioning Accuracy
requirements.statement: The system shall maintain positional accuracy of ≤ 5m (T), 4m (O) in contested environments.

requirements.name: Threat Zone Avoidance
requirements.statement: The system shall automatically reroute missions to avoid known threat zones.

requirements.name: Satellite Relay
requirements.statement: The system shall reroute mission data through relay satellites if direct ground links are jammed.

requirements.name: Pre-Comm Authentication
requirements.statement: The system shall authenticate all receiving aircraft before data exchange.

requirements.name: Low-Latency Commands
requirements.statement: The system shall maintain ≤ 15ms (T), 10ms (O) latency in command transmission.

requirements.name: Anti-Jamming Hopping
requirements.statement: The system shall employ frequency-hopping techniques to counter jamming attempts.

requirements.name: Communication Uptime
requirements.statement: The system shall sustain communication uptime of ≥ 99.8% (T), 99.9% (O) between receiving aircraft.

requirements.name: Data Loss Limit
requirements.statement: The system shall have data packet loss of ≤ 0.2% (T), 0.1% (O).

requirements.name: Unauthorized Connection Termination
requirements.statement: The system shall terminate unauthenticated connections.

requirements.name: RF Masking
requirements.statement: The system shall employ RF signature masking techniques during covert operations.

requirements.name: Certificate Validation
requirements.statement: The system shall validate digital certificates for all receiving aircrafts.

requirements.name: Message Integrity During Jamming
requirements.statement: The system shall achieve ≥ 98% (T), 99% (O) message integrity during jamming.

requirements.name: Zero-Trust Network
requirements.statement: The system shall implement a zero-trust network architecture, verifying all access requests regardless of origin.

requirements.name: Encryption Recovery
requirements.statement: The system shall re-establish encrypted communication within 5 seconds (T), 4 seconds (O) of signal loss.

requirements.name: Tampered Data Erase
requirements.statement: The system shall erase sensitive data and notify ground control if tampering is detected.

requirements.name: Quantum Encryption
requirements.statement: The system shall use quantum-resistant encryption algorithms.

requirements.name: AES-256 Encryption
requirements.statement: The system shall encrypt all communications using AES-256 encryption protocol.

requirements.name: Obstacle Detection Range
requirements.statement: The system shall detect obstacles within 500m (T), 750m (O) with 99% accuracy.

requirements.name: Collision Rerouting
requirements.statement: The system shall automatically reroute flight paths to avoid collisions.

requirements.name: Aircraft Separation
requirements.statement: The system shall maintain ≥ 100m (T), 150m (O) separation from non-receiving aircraft.

requirements.name: Collision Update Frequency
requirements.statement: The system shall update collision risk assessments every 0.5 seconds.

requirements.name: Collision Avoidance Priority
requirements.statement: The system shall prioritize collision avoidance over mission timelines.

requirements.name: Foreign Object Detection
requirements.statement: The system shall detect birds/foreign objects ≥ 10cm (T), 7cm (O) wide.

requirements.name: False Alert Limit
requirements.statement: The system shall limit false collision alerts to no more than two (T) one (O) per mission.

requirements.name: Predictive Obstacles Algorithms
requirements.statement: The system shall employ predictive algorithms for obstacle trajectories and avoidance.

requirements.name: Terrain Avoidance
requirements.statement: The system shall avoid terrain obstacles located below 500m (T), 750m (O) above ground level (AGL)

requirements.name: Collision Expectancy
requirements.statement: The system shall have on average, a collision expectancy of no more than once every 1,000,000 mission hours (T) 1,500,000 (O) mission hours.

requirements.name: Redundant Pumps
requirements.statement: The system shall have redundant fuel pumps.

requirements.name: Power Loss Safe Mode
requirements.statement: The system shall default to safe mode during power loss.

requirements.name: Triple Redundancy
requirements.statement: The system shall employ triple-redundant flight control systems.

requirements.name: Backup Power
requirements.statement: The system shall have backup power for critical subsystems.

requirements.name: Hydraulic Isolation
requirements.statement: The system shall automatically detect and isolate hydraulic failures to ensure faulting does not propegate throughout the rest of the system.

requirements.name: Dual Data Buses
requirements.statement: The system shall employ dual-redundant data buses.

requirements.name: Boom Fail-Safe Locks
requirements.statement: The system shall include fail-safe mechanical locks for the refueling boom.

requirements.name: Redundant IMUs
requirements.statement: The system shall include redundant inertial measurement units (IMUs).

requirements.name: Mission Success Rate
requirements.statement: The system shall achieve ≥95% mission success rate under nominal conditions.

requirements.name: Failure Logging
requirements.statement: The system shall log mission failures for post-mission diagnostics.

requirements.name: Fault Recovery Time
requirements.statement: The system shall recover from faults and resume operations within 2 minutes (T), 1 minute (O).

requirements.name: Mission Abort Limit
requirements.statement: The system shall limit mission aborts caused by subsystem failures to ≤ 3% (T), 2% (O).

requirements.name: Data Archival
requirements.statement: The system shall archive mission data for ≥ 30 days (T), 45 days post-operation.

requirements.name: Post-Mission Reports
requirements.statement: The system shall generate post-mission performance reports.

requirements.name: Status Notifications
requirements.statement: The system shall notify operators of mission success/failure within 1 minute (T), 30 seconds (O).

requirements.name: False Abort Limit
requirements.statement: The system shall limit false-positive mission aborts to no more than 2% (T), 1% (O).

requirements.name: Fuel Compatibility Check
requirements.statement: The system shall validate fuel compatibility between receiving aircraft before transfer.

requirements.name: Pump Fault Detection
requirements.statement: The system shall detect faults in fuel pumps within 5 seconds (T), 2 seconds (O).

requirements.name: Predictive Pump Analysis
requirements.statement: The system shall implement algorithms to predict pump failures using vibrational analysis.

requirements.name: Fuel Temperature Monitoring
requirements.statement: The system shall monitor fuel temperature within 2C (T), 1C (O) accuracy.

requirements.name: Hydraulic Fault Speed
requirements.statement: The system shall identify and diagnose hydraulic system faults in ≤ 10 seconds (T), 5 seconds (O).

requirements.name: Sensor Isolation
requirements.statement: The system shall isolate faulty sensors during diagnostics.

requirements.name: Low Pressure Alert
requirements.statement: The system shall alert operators of low fuel pressure.

requirements.name: Log Archive
requirements.statement: The system shall archive diagnostics logs for ≥ 1 year (T), 2 years (O).

requirements.name: FAA Compliance
requirements.statement: The system shall comply with FAA airworthiness standards.

requirements.name: MIL-STD-882E Compliance
requirements.statement: The system shall meet or exceed MIL-STD-882E safety protocols.

requirements.name: NATO Cybersecurity
requirements.statement: The system shall adhere to NATO cybersecurity standards.

requirements.name: EMI Compliance
requirements.statement: The system shall pass electromagnetic interference (EMI) testing.

requirements.name: STANAG 4406 Compliance
requirements.statement: The system shall comply with STANAG 4406 for secure messaging to all NATO platforms.

requirements.name: Penetration Testing
requirements.statement: The system shall successfully pass all cybersecurity penetration tests with no exploitable vulnerabilities detected.

requirements.name: ICAO Annex 6 Compliance
requirements.statement: The system shall meet or exceed ICAO Annex 6 safety requirements.

requirements.name: DO-178C Compliance
requirements.statement: The system shall comply with DO-178C for software airworthiness.

requirements.name: Jamming Detection
requirements.statement: The system shall detect jamming signals within 10 seconds (T), 8 seconds (O) and transmit alerts to ground control.

requirements.name: Threat Countermeasures
requirements.statement: The system shall employ countermeasures in the event of airborne threats.

requirements.name: Breach Containment
requirements.statement: The system shall detect and contain cybersecurity breaches by automatically disconnecting impacted systems.

requirements.name: GPS Spoof Detection
requirements.statement: The system shall detect spoofed GPS signals within 6 seconds (T), 2 seconds (O).

requirements.name: Cyberattack System Disabling
requirements.statement: The system shall disable non-critical systems during cyberattacks to minimize impact from potentially compromised systems.

requirements.name: Jamming Mitigation
requirements.statement: The system shall mitigate jamming attempts within 30 seconds (T), 15 seconds (O).

requirements.name: Threat Uptime
requirements.statement: The system shall have 99% (T) 99.9% (O) uptime during threat conditions.

requirements.name: Threat Logging
requirements.statement: The system shall log all threat responses for post-mission review.

requirements.name: Countermeasure Updates
requirements.statement: The system shall update countermeasure protocols via over-the-air (OTA) updates within 24 hours (T), 12 hours (O) of new threat identification

requirements.name: Threat Alert Priority
requirements.statement: The system shall prioritize threat alerts over non-critical communications during contested operations.

requirements.name: Annual Autonomy Testing
requirements.statement: The system shall meet all requirements of the autonomous mode test protocols each year.

requirements.name: Sensor Accuracy Validation
requirements.statement: The system shall validate sensor accuracy during testing to ±1% (T), ±0.5% (O) during testing.

requirements.name: Sandbox Software Testing
requirements.statement: The system shall validate all software updates in a sandbox environment before flight implementation.

requirements.name: Algorithm Test Coverage
requirements.statement: The system shall ensure that all autonomous algorithms are thoroughly tested, achieving 98% (T), 100% (O) test coverage for autonomous algorithms against DO-178C standards and regulations.

requirements.name: Sensor Calibration
requirements.statement: The system shall calibrate sensors to 0.5% (T), 0.25% (O) error margin semi-annually.

requirements.name: Software Checksum
requirements.statement: The system shall verify software integrity via checksum check pre-deployment.

requirements.name: Hardware Durability Testing
requirements.statement: The system shall validate hardware durability over 8,000 (T) operational hours, 10,000 (O) operational hours.

requirements.name: HMI Mission Display
requirements.statement: The HMI shall display real-time mission schedules, queued aircraft status, and threat alerts for operators.

requirements.name: Manual Override Speed
requirements.statement: The HMI shall allow manual override within 2.5 seconds (T), 2 seconds (O).

requirements.name: Emergency Shutdown
requirements.statement: The HMI shall include emergency shutdown controls.

requirements.name: Tactile Alerts
requirements.statement: The HMI shall provide tactile feedback for critical alerts.

requirements.name: Voice Command Support
requirements.statement: The HMI shall support voice commands for operator actions.

requirements.name: HMI Refresh Rate
requirements.statement: The HMI shall display graphical data at 30 Hz (T), 60 Hz (O).

requirements.name: Subsystem Health Display
requirements.statement: The HMI shall display subsystem health using red (fault), yellow (degraded), and green (nominal) per MIL-STD-1472G.

requirements.name: Multilingual HMI
requirements.statement: The HMI shall include the option for multilingual support for operators.

requirements.name: Operator Action Logging
requirements.statement: The HMI shall log operator actions and system context for audit purposes.

requirements.name: Haptic Emergency Alerts
requirements.statement: The HMI shall provide haptic feedback to operators for emergency alerts.

requirements.name: HMI Update Speed
requirements.statement: The HMI shall update status displays every 0.5 seconds (T), 0.2 seconds (O).

requirements.name: Ground Dashboard Integration
requirements.statement: The HMI shall integrate with ground control station dashboards.

requirements.name: Critical Control Lockdown
requirements.statement: The HMI shall disable non-essential controls during critical emergencies.

requirements.name: Manual Override Instructions
requirements.statement: The HMI shall provide step-by-step instructions for manual override.

requirements.name: Refueling Queue Reprioritization
requirements.statement: The HMI shall allow operators to manually reprioritize refueling queues during emergencies.

requirements.name: Component Replacement Time
requirements.statement: The system shall support the replacement of critical components to restore operational capability within 4 hours (T), 2 hours (O).

requirements.name: Modular Subsystems
requirements.statement: The system shall utilize modular subsystems to enable independent upgrades.

requirements.name: Mean Repair Time
requirements.statement: The system shall have a mean repair time (MTTR) of 2 hours (T), 1.5 hours (O).

requirements.name: Obsolescence Management
requirements.statement: The system shall implement a 10-year obsolescence management strategy.

requirements.name: Lifecycle Cost Estimates
requirements.statement: The system shall provide lifecycle cost estimates for sustainment.

requirements.name: Maintenance Training
requirements.statement: The system shall include training simulators for maintenance crews.

requirements.name: Repair Documentation
requirements.statement: The system shall document all repair procedures for field use.

requirements.name: KC-46 Integration
requirements.statement: The system shall integrate with existing KC-46 tankers without structural modifications.

requirements.name: Future Tanker Compatibility
requirements.statement: The system shall support software updates to maintain compatibility with future tanker models.

requirements.name: MIL-STD-1553 Compliance
requirements.statement: The system shall comply with MIL-STD-1553 for interfacing with tanker avionics to ensure common interfacing.

requirements.name: Tanker Integration Time
requirements.statement: The system shall maintain integration times with new tanker models within 48 hours (T), 36 hours (O).

requirements.name: Tanker Power Compatibility
requirements.statement: The system shall interface with tanker power supply outputs of 28VDC nominal.

requirements.name: Tanker Fuel Validation
requirements.statement: The system shall validate and log tanker fuel quantities before mission start.

requirements.name: Tanker Waypoint Sync
requirements.statement: The system shall synchronize its navigation data with tanker waypoints.

requirements.name: Tanker Navigation Interface
requirements.statement: The system shall interface with tanker navigation systems.

requirements.name: Tanker Health Reporting
requirements.statement: The system shall send tanker health data to ground stations.

requirements.name: Link 16 Compliance
requirements.statement: The system shall comply with Link 16 messaging protocols.

requirements.name: Tanker Data Bus Auto-Detection
requirements.statement: The system shall automatically detect and configure tanker-specific data buses.

requirements.name: Fuel Data Sync
requirements.statement: The system shall synchronize fuel data with tanker fuel data logistical systems.

requirements.name: Tanker Comm Latency
requirements.statement: The system shall have a communications interface latency of 5ms (T), 3ms (O) for critical commands.

requirements.name: Tanker Integration Size/Weight
requirements.statement: The system shall not exceed 750 kg (T), 500 kg (O) or 3 cubic meters (T), 2 cubic meters (O) in size/weight during tanker integration.

requirements.name: Fuel Transfer Rate
requirements.statement: The system shall transfer fuel at 1,200 gallons/minute (T), 3000 gallons/minute(O).

requirements.name: Downtime Reporting Accuracy
requirements.statement: The system shall report downtime metrics within 2% (T), 1% (O) error.

requirements.name: Fuel Schedule Optimization
requirements.statement: The system shall employ an optimized fuel transfering schedule based on receiving aircraft priority.

requirements.name: Fuel Waste Limit
requirements.statement: The system shall limit fuel waste to no more than 1.0% (T), 0.5% (O) of the total fuel consumed in each mission

requirements.name: Fuel Transfer Accuracy
requirements.statement: The system shall ensure that actual fuel transfer volumes are within 5.0% (T), 3.0% (O) of the planned values.

requirements.name: Turbulence Minimization
requirements.statement: The system shall adjust fuel flow to minimize receiving aircraft turbulence.

requirements.name: Fuel Quality Check
requirements.statement: The system shall verify fuel quality before transfer.

requirements.name: Transfer Completion Reporting
requirements.statement: The system shall report fuel transfer completion within 5 seconds (T), 10 seconds (O).

requirements.name: Low-Fuel Priority
requirements.statement: The system shall prioritize refueling for low-fuel receiving aircraft first.

requirements.name: Predictive Maintenance
requirements.statement: The system shall automatically update its maintenance schedule by analyzing performance metrics to determine if maintenance is likely required

requirements.name: Refueling Request Processing
requirements.statement: The system shall receive, authenticate, and process refueling requests from ground control via satellite within 10 seconds (T), 8 seconds (O).

requirements.name: Refueling Priority Logic
requirements.statement: The system shall prioritize refueling requests based on aircraft fuel urgency, mission criticality, and operational efficiency algorithms.

requirements.name: Schedule Generation Speed
requirements.statement: The system shall generate a refueling schedule and broadcast it to queued aircraft and the ground within 30 seconds (T), 20 seconds (O) of mission assignment.

requirements.name: Dynamic Schedule Updates
requirements.statement: The system shall update schedules dynamically in response to new requests or mission disruptions (e.g., threats, weather).

requirements.name: Post-Mission Reporting
requirements.statement: The system shall generate and transmit post-mission reports (fuel transferred, anomalies, threats) to ground control within 5 minutes (T), 3 minutes (O) of mission completion.

requirements.name: Mission Status Updates
requirements.statement: The system shall transmit mission status updates to ground control every 30 seconds.

requirements.name: System Integration Effort
requirements.statement: The system shall require no more than 100 (T), 80 (O) integration man-hours per subsystem interface as measured during system integration testing.

requirements.name: Subsystem TRL
requirements.statement: Each subsystem shall achieve a Technology Readiness Level (TRL) of 6 (T), 8 (O) prior to integration.

requirements.name: Subsystem Backup Activation Time
requirements.statement: The system shall activate backup subsystems within 2 seconds (T), 1 second (O) of primary subsystem failure.

requirements.name: Backup sensing and navigation
requirements.statement: The system shall have one (T), three (O) distinct navigation system redundancy modalities.

requirements.name: Antijam resistance
requirements.statement: The system shall maintain functionality through 55 dBm (T), 65 dBm (O) jamming attempts.

requirements.name: Sensor Fusion Switch Time
requirements.statement: The system shall automatically switch between active sensor inputs (radar, LIDAR, and M-code GPS) within 1.5 seconds (T), 1.0 second (O) upon detecting sensor performance degradation.

requirements.name: Flight Control Synchronization
requirements.statement: The system shall ensure that the triple-redundant flight control modules synchronize command execution within 100 ms (T), 50 ms (O) of each other.

requirements.name: Antenna Redundancy Failover Time
requirements.statement: The system shall detect a primary antenna degredation and switch to the secondary antenna within 500 ms (T), 300 ms (O) of failure detection.

requirements.name: Fuel Pump Redundancy Activation Time
requirements.statement: The system shall activate a redundant fuel pump and maintain continuous fuel transfer within 3 seconds (T), 2 seconds (O) after detecting a primary pump fault.

requirements.name: Power Subsystem Failover Time
requirements.statement: The system shall detect a primary power failure and switch to backup UPS and distribution within 2 seconds (T), 1 second (O).

requirements.name: Processing Data Fusion Latency
requirements.statement: The system shall fuse and process sensor data from the AGNS subsystem and update system status within 500 ms (T), 300 ms (O) under nominal operational conditions.

requirements.name: System MTBCF
requirements.statement:
The system shall achieve a Mean Time Between Critical Failures (MTBCF) of ≥ 500 (T), 750 (O) flight hours. 

Critical Failure is defined as mission abort or safety impact

requirements.name: System Operational Availability
requirements.statement:
The system shall achieve an Operational Availability (Ao) of ≥ 99.0% (T), 99.5% (O) during scheduled mission periods.

Ao is calculated as Uptime / (Uptime + Downtime).

requirements.name: AGNS Subsystem MTBCF
requirements.statement:
The AGNS subsystem shall demonstrate an MTBCF of ≥ 1000 (T), 1500 (O) flight hours.

Critical Failure is defined as mission abort or safety impact

requirements.name: LRU MTTR
requirements.statement: The Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) for any subsytem shall be ≤ 2.0 (T), 1.5 (O) hours.

requirements.name: BIT Fault Isolation
requirements.statement: The ANGARS system Built-In-Test (BIT) shall detect ≥ 98% of critical failures and isolate ≥ 90% (T), 95% (O) of detected critical failures to a single subsystem.

requirements.name: Emergency Fuel Cutoff Time
requirements.statement: The system shall activate the emergency fuel transfer cutoff sequence within ≤ .2s (T), .1s (O)  of receiving a cutoff command or detecting a critical anomaly.

requirements.name: Safety Program Compliance
requirements.statement: The system safety program shall be conducted in accordance with MIL-STD-882E, including hazard analysis and risk assessment.

requirements.name: Sensor Conflict Safety Logic
requirements.statement: The system shall prioritize maintaining safe separation based on the in the event of conflicting sensor data regarding collision detection.

requirements.name: HMI Display Contrast Ratio
requirements.statement: All text and critical symbology displayed on the Operator HMI panel shall maintain a minimum contrast ratio of 7:1 (T), 10:1 (O) under ambient lighting from 100 to 1000 lux.

requirements.name: Manual Control Latency
requirements.statement: The system shall have no more than ≤ .25s (T), .2s (O) between the time an operator inputs for manual boom control to result in corresponding boom actuator response.

requirements.name: -ilities (Rel)
requirements.statement: The system shall achieve a mission reliability of ≥ 98% (T), 99.5% (O) for a standard 10-hour refueling mission profile.

requirements.name: -ilities (Maint)
requirements.statement: The system's shall isolate detected critical failures classified as impacting safety or mission success to a single subsystem within 5 minutes (T), 2 minutes (O) of BIT completion.

requirements.name: -ilities (Log)
requirements.statement: The system shall track the operational hours/cycles for 100% of the limited-life components and generate maintenance alerts when their predefined thresholds are reached.

requirements.name: HSI
requirements.statement: The system shall ensure critical warning and caution alert text displayed on the primary Human-Machine Interface (HMI) uses a minimum font size equivalent to 18 points (T) / 20 points (O).

requirements.name: HSI
requirements.statement: The system shall ensure its Human-Machine Interface (HMI) provides clear, unambiguous feedback to the operator indicating the reason for an invalid command or data entry rejection within 1 second (T) / 0.5 seconds (O).

requirements.name: Interface
requirements.statement: The system shall ensure loading on critical internal data buses does not exceed 70% (T), 60% (O) of the maximum rated bus capacity during simulated peak operational scenarios.

requirements.name: Interface
requirements.statement: The system shall maintain time synchronization across critical subsystems (AGNS, C&C, Processing, Comms) with an accuracy of ± 1 millisecond (ms) (T), ± 0.1 millisecond (ms) (O) relative to actual time.
